title: PG, hostel and rental property management software
desc: Rooms and beds, tenants, monthly rent with UPI reminders and receipts, deposits and move-outs, complaints, expenses and a tenant app. A concept build for PG owners and landlords.
tag: For PG, hostel and rental owners
h1: Know who has paid, who has not, and who is leaving.
lead: Rooms, beds, tenants and monthly rent in one place. Send UPI reminders, print receipts, settle deposits at move-out and give tenants an app to pay and raise complaints.
fH2: Everything an owner chases each month
features: See every property, room and bed. Occupied beds show the tenant, vacant beds invite a move-in.
Contact, occupation, KYC status, deposit, food plan and joining date for each tenant, with a full payment history.
A monthly view of what is due, paid, part paid or overdue. Collect a payment and print a receipt in a few taps.
Reminders that carry a UPI link
One tap opens WhatsApp with the amount due and a link to pay. Remind everyone who is overdue from one list.
Move a tenant into a vacant bed with the right rent and deposit. At move-out, rent owed and damages come off the deposit refund.
Log maintenance issues and track them to resolved. Record electricity, salaries and repairs to see net income by property.
splits: A map of every bed you own
Properties, rooms and beds laid out with the occupant's name. Vacant beds are one click from a move-in.
Chase the right people, not everyone
Pick a month, see who has paid and who has not, and remind only those who are past the due date.
Payments tenants report wait for your OK
Tenants help you run the place
Tenants open their dues, pay by UPI, raise a complaint and read your notices from their phone.
steps: Enter rooms with beds, rent and whether they are AC. The map is ready.
Record each tenant with deposit, food plan and joining date. Rent starts from that month.
Collect on the 1st, remind on the 6th, and check net income by property at month end.
faq: They pay by UPI from the tenant app and tell you they have paid. You confirm it and the ledger updates. A production build can reconcile automatically with a payment gateway.
How is the deposit refund worked out?
The deposit minus any rent still owed and any damage charges you enter.
Yes. A food plan adds a monthly amount to the rent for that tenant.

ctaH: Move a tenant in and collect their first rent.
ctaP: Open the rooms map, add a tenant to a vacant bed and record a payment.
